title: Triage result
description: What the router and the document-shape classifier hand to whoever runs next. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

task_class.description: The kind of work, decided before the route. MULTI_DOMAIN means no single class dominates and the router re-enters.

primary_risk.description: One sentence: what goes wrong if this is routed badly. Not a restatement of the task.

primary_agent.description: Includes the router itself, which is how MULTI_DOMAIN re-entry is expressed rather than left implicit.

execution_plan.description: Ordered steps. Lightweight by default: sequence, handoffs, gates.

validation_gates.description: Objects, not strings: the triage rule is that no gate is named without the risk it retires.

document_shape.description: Set by the document-shape classifier. Absent when the task was not a shape question.

template_path.description: The template the shape selects, relative to the repository root.

next_action.description: The single best immediate move. One action, not a plan.

allOf.description: A shape decision that names ADR, RFC or RESEARCH names the template it selects.
